info.name: Accreditation Research Agent API
info.description:
UGC / AICTE accreditation research engine (v1.1.2).

Input: `university_name` (mandatory) + optional `institute_name`, `degree`, `state`.
Output: Accredited / Non-Accredited, accreditation proof (PDF), body (UGC/AICTE), URL, country.

Set `baseUrl` (default http://127.0.0.1:8100). `apiKey` is only needed when the server sets `ARA_API_KEYS`. Run a research request first: it stores `requestId` for the report/PDF requests.

Full contract: status/api.md · Swagger: {{baseUrl}}/docs

item.name: Research
item.description: POST /v1/accreditation/research — one call returns the full result (≈10–30 s).
